title: Tell him if he smokes he won’t grow. O let him! His life isn’t such a bed of roses
html_source:
Bloom wants to warn the boy about the harm of smoking, but then he understands that the cigarette helps him to forget about his hard life. Boy smokes and forgets about the problems-an example relating to the Lotus-Eaters.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: I would also state the imagery of “bed of roses” compared to lotuses.
